display.purpose: Card and section titles only; the largest text in the product, no marketing hero scale.

body.purpose: Default UI text — labels, table cells, descriptions, form values.

label.purpose: Metadata and badge text; medium weight carries emphasis, not letter-spacing.

mono.purpose: Service IDs, hashes, ports, trace IDs, log lines, generated SQL.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Cards, inputs, sidebar, app shell — flat at rest.

shadows.name: floating-menu
shadows.purpose: Dropdown and context menus, combined with ring-1 ring-foreground/10.

shadows.name: floating-modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, sheets, command palette, combined with ring-1 ring-foreground/10.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action button — Signal Blue fill, white text, 32px height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; gap: 6px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.50 0.20 218); color: oklch(0.985 0.006 220); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.50 0.20 218) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.60 0.175 218); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.60 0.175 218 / 50%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline border, transparent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; gap: 6px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.904 0.010 220); background: oklch(0.985 0.006 220); color: oklch(0.215 0.030 220); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.945 0.012 220); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.60 0.175 218); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.60 0.175 218 / 50%); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Severity/status pill — outline variant, text and border share the status color, background stays neutral.
components.css: .ds-badge-critical { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: oklch(0.52 0.20 28); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; background: oklch(1 0.003 220); border-radius: 22.4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.215 0.03 220 / 10%); padding: 16px; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.215 0.030 220); } .ds-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.458 0.022 220); } .ds-badge-healthy { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.96 0.04 145); color: oklch(0.48 0.15 145); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field — hairline border, blue focus ring, matches button focus language.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.904 0.010 220); background: transparent; font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.215 0.030 220); transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.458 0.022 220); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.60 0.175 218); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.60 0.175 218 / 50%); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.233 28); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.233 28 / 20%); }

narrative.overview: Cartogra puts an operator in front of a live system, not a marketing surface. The visual language is built for someone who needs to answer "is this safe to ship" in seconds: a single UI family (Geist Variable, used for headings, body, and labels alike — no display/body pairing), a restrained blue accent reserved for action and selection, and a flat, ring-bordered surface system that reads as instrument-panel calm rather than dashboard clutter. Depth appears only where it's functional — floating layers (menus, dialogs) lift off the canvas with a soft shadow; everything at rest stays flat, separated by hairline rings instead of shadows. This system explicitly rejects the three anti-references named in PRODUCT.md: it does not sugarcoat complexity with a gimmicky, overly-friendly tone; it is not a generic, checkbox-driven enterprise dashboard; and it does not spend visual budget on decoration that doesn't change a decision. Status color (critical / warning / success / info) is the one place saturation is allowed to run high, because status is the one thing that must be recognized instantly and without ambiguity.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface family (Geist Variable) across every text role; JetBrains Mono reserved strictly for IDs, hashes, and machine-generated data.
Restrained color: neutral cool-blue surfaces, one signal-blue accent for actions and selection, four non-negotiable status hues for health/severity.
Flat-at-rest, ring-bordered surfaces; shadow appears only on floating/overlay layers (dropdowns, dialogs, sheets).
Generous corner radii (16-22px) on containers read as considered rather than sharp, without tipping into playful.

rules.name: The Single Source Rule
rules.body: Every status color in the codebase resolves through exactly four CSS custom properties (--critical, --warning, --success, --info), each with a -subtle wash. No component defines its own status oklch literal.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue appears on primary buttons, active selection, links, and focus rings only. If an element isn't one of those four things, it doesn't get the accent color.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: No display/body font pairing. Geist Variable is the UI font for every text role; JetBrains Mono is the only second family, reserved strictly for machine-readable data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If it's not floating above the page (menu, dialog, sheet, toast), it does not get a box-shadow. Depth at rest is a hairline ring, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep every text role in Geist Variable; reach for JetBrains Mono only for IDs, hashes, ports, and log/trace output.
Do resolve every health/severity color through the four semantic tokens (--critical, --warning, --success, --info) and their -subtle washes.
Do pair every status color with a shape or icon, never color alone.
Do keep resting surfaces flat (ring only); reserve shadow for dropdowns, dialogs, and sheets.
Do use the same focus treatment (Signal Blue border + 3px ring) on every interactive control.
Do size every interactive element for a 44px touch target on coarse-pointer devices while keeping dense desktop sizing on fine-pointer devices.
donts: Don't add a colored border-left/border-right stripe to cards, list rows, or alerts as a severity accent.
Don't introduce a second UI typeface for visual interest.
Don't add a drop shadow to a resting card, table, or panel.
Don't use Signal Blue for anything other than primary actions, selection, active nav state, links, and focus rings.
Don't sugarcoat empty/error states with cute illustrations or gimmicky copy.
Don't ship a checkbox-driven, bloated settings screen.
Don't reach for a modal as the first solution.
